meta.title: TikTok Creator
meta.description: Record a short clip. Get one ready-to-post TikTok video.

welcome.headline: Your story, ready for TikTok
welcome.promise: Record a short clip. Get one polished 9:16 video — ready to post.
welcome.privacy: Your clip stays private until you download or share it.

ideas.title: What do you want to share?
ideas.subtitle: Pick one to get started

daily_life.label: Daily Life
daily_life.hint: Show a moment from your day — morning routine, commute, work, or evening.

farming_tip.label: Farming Tip
farming_tip.hint: Share one thing you know about farming, crops, or livestock.

village.label: My Village
village.hint: Show your community, neighbourhood, or the view outside your window.

food.label: My Food
food.hint: Cook something, show a dish, or describe your favourite local food.

skill.label: My Skill
skill.hint: Demonstrate a craft, trade, or talent you have.

funny_story.label: Funny Story
funny_story.hint: Tell a short funny story — something that made you laugh recently.

answer_question.label: Answer a Question
answer_question.hint: Answer a question you often get asked, or explain something people wonder about.

surprise_me.label: Surprise Me
surprise_me.hint: Record anything — we will make it look great.

record.title: Record your clip
record.permissionHelp: Open your browser settings and allow camera + microphone for this site, then come back.

preview.title: Your video is ready!
preview.tiktokHint: Download the video, then open TikTok to post it.
